data.gender_notes: Fabe is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Fabe means 'youthful' or 'blossoming'. This name evokes a sense of new beginnings and growth, making it a fitting choice for a baby girl. The name Fabe carries the meaning “Youthful, Blossoming” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fabe usually hope their child will grow to embody youthful, blossoming and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fabe total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: פאבה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פאבה הוא שם נדיר שמקורו כנראה מהמילה הארמית 'אבא' שמשמעותה אבא או פאפא. השם מופיע בשינויים שונים בכתבי הקודש ובמסורות הנוצריות. הוא משויך לאביו של ישו, יוסף, ומבטא את הקשר המשפחתי והאבהי.

in_greek.name: Φάβη
in_greek.long_meaning: Φάβη είναι ένα σπάνιο όνομα που πιθανόν προέρχεται από την αραμαϊκή λέξη 'Αββά' που σημαίνει πατέρας ή παππάς. Το όνομα εμφανίζεται με διάφορες παραλλαγές στα ιερά κείμενα και στις χριστιανικές παραδόσεις. Σχετίζεται με τον πατέρα του Ιησού, Ιωσήφ, και εκφράζει τη οικογενειακή και πατρική σχέση.

in_latin.name: Fabe
in_latin.long_meaning: Fabe is a rare name likely derived from the Aramaic word 'Abba' meaning father or papa. The name appears in various forms in sacred texts and Christian traditions. It is associated with Joseph, the father of Jesus, and conveys the familial and paternal bond.

in_english.name: Fabe
in_english.meaning: Fabe means devoted to fatherly love or paternal bond
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fabe originates from the Aramaic term 'Abba,' signifying a deep paternal connection. It reflects the fatherly love and devotion, often linked to Joseph, the earthly father of Jesus. Historically, the name conveys a sense of familial loyalty and spiritual guidance. In Christian tradition, Fabe symbolizes the nurturing and protective qualities of a father figure.

This name serves as a reminder of the endless opportunities for personal growth and spiritual enrichment that come with following the teachings of Jesus Christ.
